name: Validate Shopify variant metafields CSV with PlainByte Tools

nodes.name: Start manually
nodes.notes: Manual execution only. Importing the workflow does not run the paid Actor.

nodes.name: Edit CSV and mappings
nodes.notes: One fictional variant. Replace csv_text and fields with your authorized input. No Shopify token is needed.

nodes.name: Validate with Apify - paid
nodes.notes: Select a Header Auth credential: Authorization = Bearer <your Apify token>. USD 1 per completed report (including blocked/no_changes) + USD 0.00005 per start. Cap USD 1.01 per request. Do not retry blindly after a timeout.

nodes.name: Inspect status and requests
nodes.notes: The final output is a planning report. ready requires separate review and Shopify authorization; blocked/no_changes have no requests. No Shopify writes are performed.
